svg.text: A seam observer for the DeepSeek Harness. It asks a System One model what the agent loop is doing, at the points you choose,
and writes every call, every skip and every answer to a JSONL trace. It decides nothing: its product is evidence.

svg.text: the agent-facing reader over the JSONL trace
not on the data path — the code that checks, explains and ships it
Settings card on the Plugins page, the trace card inside a
conversation, a session menu item and tool views. Each is registered
into a slot the page declares at runtime.
These measure the ruler, not the session. probe-score.js asks whether a
question separates; calibrate.js whether the confidence is worth
anything; battery.js is the only thing that can tell a better question
from a different one; compare.js whether two runs were the same
experiment; honesty.js what this record claims that nobody has checked.
`npm run ci`, in order: test · coverage (90% lines, 75% branches, 75%
`lib-map.test.js` fails when a module under lib/ is not declared in its
docs/ — the record behind the code
manual.md is the reference; findings.md is the register of every defect
with its cause, its consequence and the measurement that found it;
conventions.md is each rule with the measurement that produced it. None
packages/session-adapter — the pure half of session-shaped reading,
importable because the composer runs in a synchronous path that cannot
await a service. dsh-session-index — the store, in its own repository,
deploy/ records the profile as applied, and check-deploy says whether
it still describes the machine. scripts/trace.mjs reads the trace from
a terminal; scripts/import-deepseek-web.mjs writes a foreign transcript
as harness events. Two operator skills ship with the package.
@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools — a renamed export is refused by ESM resolution
before apply() runs. cordis.patch.yml replaces config wholesale, never
deep-merges, so the plugin list in it is a snapshot.
